$comment: Single source of truth for the Spinner API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: A turning circle that says something is loading.
thumb: Loading…

variant.description: Text colour, or the accent colour.

label.description: What screen readers hear. Leave it out (decorative) when text next to the spinner says it.

Loading.description: A spinner with a message, announced politely.

examples.title: Sizes and colour
examples.description: On its own, a spinner has role="status" and a label. It takes the text colour, or the accent with primary.

examples.title: In a button
examples.description: Put a small spinner before the label and say what's happening ("Saving…"). Disable the button while it works.

examples.title: With a message
examples.description: Loading shows a spinner with text, on the page or inside a card.

a11y: A spinner on its own has role="status" and a label, so screen readers say "Loading".
Next to text that already says it, the spinner is hidden (aria-hidden) so nothing is said twice.
With reduced motion the spinner turns slowly; with motion off it stops (still shown as an arc).
